protocol: All models scored with per-class thresholds tuned on validation patients, applied to test; seeds 42/7/123; single fixed patient-level split; MLP trained with the same optimization protocol as the GNN (AdamW, cosine schedule, boosted class weights, early stopping on validation macro-F1 with best-checkpoint selection).
notes: Paired t-test and Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-seed macro-F1 (GNN - baseline). n=3 seeds, df=2: very low power; a non-significant result does not imply no effect. Wilcoxon min achievable two-sided p at n=3 is 0.25. Two pre-specified comparisons; Bonferroni alpha=0.025 as sensitivity. IMPORTANT: all seeds share a single fixed patient-level split, so p-values quantify training-seed variability only, NOT patient-sampling (split) variability, which is likely the dominant source of uncertainty with three held-out patients.
table_note: Under the matched training + identical tuned-threshold scoring protocol, the no-graph MLP OUTPERFORMS the GNN on macro-F1 on every seed. The earlier GNN>baseline result was an artifact of scoring baselines with default argmax. Paired-test p-values reflect seed-to-seed variability under a single fixed patient split (n=3, low power).
